subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) The first friend climbed up a tree. The later could not climb up a tree. (b) Suddenly a bear came there. (c) Once upon a time two friends were passing by a forest. (d) He thought him to be dead. Then the bear went away. (e) They were talking about their love for each other. (f) He did not find any way. (g) The bear smelt his ears, nose and face. (h) He lay down on the ground and feigned death.
guide_solution: c → e → b → a → f → h → g → d
